title: Dolce & Gabbana perfume: The One, Devotion, Q, K and Light Blue compared
body:
Dolce & Gabbana fragrances lean warm and Mediterranean: Sicilian citrus, orange blossom and spice over tobacco, amber and woods. The One is the line most people search for, but the house also makes the fresh, herbal K for men and the sweet Devotion and fruity Q for women. Here is every Dolce & Gabbana perfume we stock, with its notes, the sizes on offer and who each one suits.

The One for Men: three versions

The One for Men comes in three strengths with different notes, so it is worth knowing which is which:

  • The One for Men Eau de Parfum (£66.54, 100ml, or 150ml at £80.99): grapefruit, coriander and basil, then cardamom, ginger and orange blossom, over tobacco, amber and cedarwood. Spicy and warm, with a smooth tobacco base.
  • The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense (£70.14, 100ml): neroli, cardamom and cypress, then cashmeran, benzoin and clary sage, over leather, labdanum and patchouli. Darker and more resinous, with leather in place of tobacco.
  • The One Gold for Men Eau de Parfum Intense (£66.54, 100ml): blood orange, Sicilian bergamot and ginger, then clary sage, cardamom and geranium, over amberwood, patchouli and vetiver. Brighter at the start and woodier at the end.

Which The One for him? The eau de parfum for a warm, tobacco-spice scent; the Intense for something darker with leather; The One Gold for a citrus start and a woody finish. All three suit evenings and the colder months.

K by Dolce & Gabbana

The K Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£56.94, 50ml plus a 5ml travel spray) is the fresher choice for men: blood orange, Sicilian lemon and juniper berries, then clary sage, geranium, lavender and fig nectar, over cedarwood, vetiver, patchouli and nagarmotha. Herbal and citrusy, it works for the office and the daytime.

Devotion

Devotion Eau de Parfum (£62.94, 100ml) is a gourmand for women with a short, clear list: candied citrus at the top, orange blossom in the heart and Madagascar vanilla in the base. Sweet, warm and creamy. The Devotion Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£58.99) pairs a 50ml bottle with a 10ml travel spray.

Q by Dolce & Gabbana

Q Eau de Parfum (£70.86, 100ml) is a fruity floral: Sicilian lemon, blood orange and jasmine, then cherry and heliotrope, over cedarwood and musk. Bright and juicy at first, softer and powdery later.

The One for Women and L'Imperatrice

The One for Women Eau de Parfum Gift Set (peach, lychee, mandarin and bergamot; lily, plum and jasmine; vanilla, amber, musk and vetiver) and L'Imperatrice Eau de Toilette (kiwi, rhubarb and pink pepper; watermelon, cyclamen and jasmine; musk, sandalwood and lemon tree) are out of stock at present: use Notify me on the page and we will email you when they are back.

Light Blue and the miniature sets

We do not stock a full bottle of Light Blue at present, but it is in both miniature sets, which are also the easiest way to try the range:

  • Women's Miniature Fragrance Set (£39.99): Devotion, Q, Blue Jasmine (fig, jasmine sambac, cedarwood) and The One in 5ml, plus Light Blue Eau de Toilette 4.5ml (Sicilian lemon, apple, jasmine, cedarwood, musk).
  • Men's Miniature Fragrance Set (£34.99): Devotion, K Eau de Toilette, K Eau de Parfum and The One in 5ml, plus Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Toilette (citrus, juniper, rosemary, musk, woods).

Which Dolce & Gabbana perfume should you choose?

  • A warm, spicy scent for him: The One for Men Eau de Parfum.
  • Darker, with leather: The One for Men Intense.
  • Fresh and herbal for him: K.
  • A sweet vanilla scent for her: Devotion.
  • A fruity floral for her: Q.
  • Light Blue, or not sure yet: one of the miniature sets.

Good to know

  • Eau de parfum, intense or eau de toilette? Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.
  • Buying a gift? See our mini perfume sets guide and perfume gift sets guide.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.
